I or T: A2 [ I or T ] to attempt to do something

C usually singular: B2 [ C usually singular ] an attempt to do something

T: B1 [ T ] to test something to see if it is suitable or useful or if it works
› used by many people and proved to be effective
經反復考驗證實是有效的
C2 [ T ] to examine a person accused of committing a crime in a law court by asking them questions and considering known facts, and then decide if they are guilty
› [ T ] to worry or annoy someone or upset a person's patience with many, often slight, difficulties

C: › [ C ] (in the game of rugby) the act of a player putting the ball on the ground behind the opposing team's goal line, which scores points for the player's team
（橄欖球運動中）在對方球門線後帶球觸地得分

example: Keep trying and you'll find a job eventually.
不斷努力，你最終會找到工作的。
If I don't get into the academy this year, I'll try again next year.
如果今年進不了這所專科學校，我明年還會努力。
I've tried really hard but I can't convince him to come.
儘管我很努力勸他，但他就是不來。
I'm trying my best/hardest, but I just can't do it.
我在盡最大努力，可就是做不來。
[ + to infinitive ] I tried to open the window.
我試著想打開窗戶。
[ + -ing verb ] Maybe you should try getting up (= you should get up) earlier.
也許早晨你應該早點起床。
I tried that recipe you gave me last night.
我昨晚嘗試了你給我的那個食譜。
We don't sell newspapers - have you tried the coffee shop on the corner?
我們不賣報紙，你去拐角處的那家商店問過嗎？
[ + -ing verb ] Try using a different shampoo.
試著用一下另一種洗髮水。
I'd like to try parachuting.
我想我可能會嘗試一下跳傘。
I forgot my door-keys - we'd better try the window (= test it to see if it is open).
我忘了帶門鎖匙——我們最好試試窗戶是否開著。
Most people would prefer to stick to tried and tested methods of birth control.
大多數人都會選擇繼續使用已經反復驗證過的節約方法。
Because of security implications the officers were tried in secret.
出於安全上的考慮，那些軍官受到秘密審判。
They are being tried for murder.
他們因謀殺正在被審訊。
The demands of the job have tried him sorely.
這項工作的苛刻要求使他深受折磨。
He's been trying my patience all morning with his constant questions.
他整個早晨都在不停地問我問題，令我煩透了。
Her endless demands would try the patience of a saint (= are very annoying).
他無休止的要求，即使一個聖者也會忍無可忍。
They might still have tickets left - why don't you give it a try?
他們可能還有剩餘的票——你為什麼不試試呢？
This will be her third try at jumping the bar.
這將是她第三次嘗試跳過橫杆。
You could ask him if he's willing - it's worth a try.
你可以問他是否願意——這值得一試。

NONE: › to attempt to get something
試圖獲得；爭取，謀求

example: Are you going to try for that job in the sales department?
你想爭取銷售部的那份工作嗎？

NONE: › to deceive someone or behave badly, especially in order to discover how much of your bad behaviour will be allowed
向…行騙；對…粗魯無禮；耍弄

example: He's not really ill - he's just trying it on.
他並不是真的病了——他只是在耍花招。
The kids often try it on with a new babysitter.
孩子們常常耍弄新來的保姆。

NONE: › to compete for a position in a sports team or a part in a play
參加（運動隊的）選拔；參加（劇組的）試演

example: Luke's trying out for the college football team.
盧克正在參加大學足球隊的選拔。

NONE: › to test something or to think about an idea in order to decide if it works or if you can use it
試用…看是否可用；考慮…看是否合適
A2 to put on a piece of clothing to discover if it fits you or if you like it
試穿；試戴

example: Try on the shoes to see if they fit.
試試那雙鞋子，看合不合適。
What a gorgeous dress - why don't you try it on for size (= to discover whether it fits)?
多漂亮的裙子啊——你為甚麼不穿上試試呢？

NONE: B2 to use something to discover if it works or if you like it
試用；試驗；檢驗

example: Don't forget to try out the equipment before setting up the experiment.
別忘了在安裝實驗設備以前檢驗一下。

NONE: › to find out what someone thinks about something
了解（某人）對（某事）的看法

example: We tried out the new song on a couple of friends, but they didn't like it.
我們給幾位朋友試唱了新歌，但是他們都不喜歡。

NONE: › to try doing something for the first time
初次嘗試做

example: He decided to try his hand at knitting and discovered he was good at it.
他決定嘗試一下編織，結果發現自己很擅長。

NONE: › to try to achieve something although you know you might not succeed
碰碰運氣

example: He'd always wanted to act and in 1959 came to London to try his luck on the stage.
他一直想從事表演，於是在1959年來到倫敦，想在舞臺上試試運氣。

NONE: › a test to see how useful or effective something or someone is
試用；選拔；試演

example: The try-outs for the team will be next weekend.
這個隊的選拔賽將在下週末舉行。
After a try-out in Bath, the play is due to open in Edinburgh next month.
在巴斯預演後，這部戲預定下月在愛丁堡開演。

NONE: › annoying and difficult
令人難受的，惱人的，令人煩惱的

example: I had a very trying day at work.
我今天上班非常不順利。
He can be trying at times.
他有時很難纏。

NONE: › an enzyme (= a chemical substance produced by living cells) that breaks down proteins
胰蛋白酶
› a meeting between two people who are having a romantic relationship, especially a secret one
約會；（尤指）幽會
